svg.title: Chronic kidney disease decision chart: the definition and stages, then four jobs side by side: slow the decline (blood pressure targets by diabetes status, ACE inhibitor or ARB, glycemic target), prevent superimposed injury, treat the complications, and plan renal replacement early
